_comment: Story gates: items from these namespaces/IDs can't be worn or right-click used until the player has the KubeJS stage (granted by FTB Quests command rewards: /kubejs stages add @p <stage>). Hero-pack namespaces filled 2026-10-28 from the mod jars on the test PC (fsang = FSang18's Heroes, ~1636 item models; satsu_iron_man_addon = Satsu Iron Man Addon); confirm against kubejs/exported/tt_item_namespaces.json after the next launch. Gods and Heroes (Palladium) isn't in the CurseForge pack yet, so its namespace is still open.

gates.message: The suit's systems stay dark. Its makers' secrets are revealed in Chapter 8: The Rise of Heroes.
